protocol.classification: invented toy parameters, MA-04/05/07/09/12/14; no calibration
limits: World samples arrive relative to shipping; waiting cost is an explicit opportunity-cost proxy, not simulated predeployment customer loss.
Availability is an externally authored earliest service tick; no shared actor service queue or dialogue is modeled.
Exact option claims, declared freshness and syntactic conflict do not establish semantic truth or source authenticity.
A holder grant is checked at receipt; it is not a delegation or authorization of the requester's selection.
No human comprehension, enjoyment, real financial effect, empirical calibration or architecture acceptance is tested.
